goal: 음원 우선 사용자가 선택한 Claude로 플랫폼 문맥 조회→내부 편집 제안→사람 승인→로컬 렌더→결과 확인을 수행할 수 있도록, 실제 전송은 하지 않고 승인되면 실행 가능한 production adapter 내부 계약의 다음 최소 수직 슬라이스를 결정한다.

sources: Existing bounded Anthropic adapter and exact-manifest/ledger/ownership contracts
Previously read installed Karpathy guidelines surgical reuse principles
methodology.applied: entrypoint→configuration→preview→approval→atomic current-reservation claim→count/message→usage→tool/result continuation tracing; ports/adapters reuse; distinguish implemented guards, unexercised production branches, actual account verification and observed billing.
methodology.limits: Source/official-research receipt read only. No provider/model GET or POST, credentials/env, browser, HTTP server or test suite was run in this task.

correction_to_initial_direction.reason: It would improve configuration but leave the main workflow permanently unavailable. The selected plan instead makes the existing production branch conditionally executable under an explicit default-off server contract, while preserving all per-round consent and cost guards. Actual activation/test is separate from implementing that internal contract.

current_trace.observation: Only --port/--data/--scene-config are accepted. server is called without general_chat_live or a credential supplier. The standard launch therefore cannot configure general Claude.

general_chat_fixture/live are mutually exclusive; live must be exact LiveTransport. Every non-test live transport is unconditionally rejected before Store creation. Existing legacy chat_configuration is a different synthetic-approved runtime, not an ordinary-general-chat connection.
Runtime accepts exact FixtureTransport or LiveTransport and unconditionally rejects non-test LiveTransport. Capability is a server configuration declaration, not account access evidence.

LiveTransport requires exact enabled AnthropicChatAdapter, bounded production count/messages classes with _opener=None, or an explicit synthetic-key-only same-port loopback pair. count and complete both unconditionally reject non-test delivery. These count/message methods are one transport defence layer; together with Runtime and server there are three layers, four rejecting sites.

Trusted transport mode/connection revision, workspace/project/conversation, selected model and price revision are bound. Exact count/message bodies, pure bounded serialization hashes, destination/endpoints, expiry, tool scope, per-round maximum and total conversation maximum enter the manifest. Each tool_result continuation requires a fresh manifest and human rights-confirmed decision.

At admission and immediately before count/message, common exposure guards run. _current and current-reservation message attempt claim are in one BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction; commit is submission-intent linearization. Post-claim edits do not rewrite approved bytes; later stale checks forbid tool effects.

AnthropicChatAdapter defaults disabled, and construction does not acquire a secret or open a connection. Only _call invokes the injected supplier for Anthropic_KEY and builds ephemeral headers. No module auto-reads environment variables. Count and complete each acquire a key lazily. Full request preflight/encoders must remain before credential acquisition in the general pipeline.

Exact https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages and /count_tokens, exact JSON/API-version/header contract, no proxies or redirects, one POST with no retry, max64KiB requests, max100000 response bytes, time/read deadline, origin/MIME/encoding/content-length checks, sanitized ProposalError. Error bodies are never read and exception strings/secrets are not persisted.

Observable response/usage is journaled before later authorization rejection. Actual non-test mode requires matching response model and richer explicit standard/zero-cache billing dimensions. Unsupported/absent/null/nonzero/unknown dimensions remain unpriced and tools do not run. Live-style valid usage is estimate, not billing-confirmed charge. Fixture mode settle behavior is not production billing.

Queued cancellation releases unsubmitted hold; in-flight cancellation blocks tools but preserves observed usage; interrupted/unknown attempts stay fenced and uncertain without automatic retry. Attempt identity includes current reservation/job/operation; turn.submitted can persist across rounds and is insufficient alone.

already_implemented.fact: Atomic existing-transaction claim verifies workspace/scope reservation-to-job binding, request/manifest hashes and existing claim fencing. It invokes require_bounded_exposure by default.

Shared budget admission checks ceiling, held/spent, uncertain costs, current revision, expiry and concurrency. Unknown exposure blocks new reservation/claim; settled/estimated amounts consume budget conservatively.
Live-style general chat invokes exposure guards at approval and count/message claims. New fake paths do not replace this production contract.
The unreachable actual general mode uses project:<project_id>, matching actual fal/start_generation project budget scope statically.

existing_tests_read_not_run: tests/test_budget_crossflow.py:competing admissions and reservation/unknown cross-flow tests
budget_guard_status.integration_gap: Current crossflow tests deliberately inject a shared rehearsal-live scope into a direct generation queue. They are evidence of common-ledger contracts, not actual production-mode HTTP chat+media routing. The production mode is blocked before these existing guards can execute through normal launch.

actual_reconciliation_gap.fact: provider_billing.reconcile only looks up generation_jobs. General chat records valid usage as estimated and billing_confirmed remains false. Late-observation review records review state, not settlement. There is no completed general-chat request-bound trusted cost-reconciliation workflow exposed by this source. A generic internal ledger.settle exists; that alone does not prove receipt attribution or an operator recovery workflow.
actual_reconciliation_gap.consequence: Do not rewrite the common ledger or claim it is absent. Also do not claim live cost/unknown recovery is fully complete. Initial clean-budget execution can be prepared safely; unattributable unknown costs must remain held until trustworthy reconciliation evidence exists.

alternatives.name: Existing bounded adapter plus explicit default-off trusted activation configuration
alternatives.benefit: Reuses exact bytes, strict tools, current approval and ledger protocol; makes the real production mode executable when explicit server configuration and every round authorization are valid.
alternatives.cost: Add one narrow configuration/factory and startup connection path; replace unconditional production guards with validated configuration predicates, not simple test_only deletion; exercise production branches offline.
alternatives.risk: Account access and actual response billing shapes remain unknown until separately approved live testing. Configuration identity is an administrative declaration, not proof of the account.

alternatives.name: New transport abstraction/SDK and separate general-chat sending runtime
alternatives.benefit: Could offer generic provider ports, but the current adapter already supplies the required first-party bounded IO.
alternatives.cost_risk: Would duplicate header/endpoint, byte encoding, secret/error handling, attempt fencing and cancellation paths; new behavior would need broad retesting without closing the actual configuration and billing-evidence gaps.
alternatives.reason_rejected: No missing transport capability was found that justifies a new SDK, retry framework or parallel execution engine.

selected_execution_plan.next_vertical_slice: Explicitly configured production-mode Claude → exact approved manifest → existing common budget/attempt claim → pinned existing adapter → validated response/tool continuation; all newly reachable production branches verified offline before any real account test.
proposed_write_set: general_chat_config.py (new, typed bounded trusted startup contract + lazy existing-adapter factory)
app.py (CLI/server construction and mutually exclusive configuration injection)
chat_general.py (three-layer validated activation predicates/binding; preserve ledger/manifest/usage state machine)
tests/test_chat_live_contract.py (retain unconfigured real mode failure; narrow additions only if existing fixtures are reused)
configuration_contract: Default disabled when the explicit startup argument/configuration is absent; constructing/validating configuration reads no credential and opens no network.

Trusted CLI/server-supplied configuration only: explicit enabled boolean, stable connection_id/revision, workspace target, pinned supported selection/price revision, permitted input/tool/cost policy and credential supplier/reference. No browser/model-supplied endpoint, headers, transport class, test_only override or secret value.

Validate bounded schema/types, duplicate/unknown keys, safe config provenance and target scope; public capabilities expose configuration/verification state without credential paths, key material or account claims.

enabled=true is an administrator opt-in for a valid configuration, not money/input consent. Every actual count/message still requires the exact manifest decision, rights confirmation, fresh model/price/connection binding, budget reservation and atomic claim.

Do not promote static catalog integration_unverified or global live_execution into successful account verification merely because construction succeeds. Runtime availability/external_transmission describe configured capability; actual account access remains explicitly unverified.

three_guard_replacements.condition: Accept actual general runtime only from validated explicit startup configuration/factory matching target workspace and pinned model/price policy; reject mixed fixture/direct-live/config inputs and retain default disconnected mode. Configuration errors occur before credential lookup and external IO.

Allow a non-test transport only if its trusted validated activation contract is present and current; retain exact class validation, current connection binding and all existing preview/decision/ledger gates. Arbitrary unconfigured LiveTransport remains rejected.

Require the same valid active contract and exact production bounded transports, no custom opener/endpoint, before delegating to the lazy adapter. UI/model routes reach this only through Runtime after existing per-operation atomic claims; this is not a public transport-execution API. Missing/disabled/stale configuration fails before secret acquisition.

implementation_order: First pin the narrow configuration/capability contract and inactive behavior; preserve the existing unconfigured-real-mode refusal test.

Wire the existing adapter/factory into CLI/server without automatic execution. Make the three actual-mode guards conditional on the same trusted contract and bind its revision/hash to each exact preview. No fixture may silently become live.

Exercise the actual production mode through isolated platform HTTP and existing bounded transports with the socket/opener seam replaced only inside tests. _opener must remain None in the production configuration. No real key or endpoint request is made. This is an offline production-branch test, not real-provider evidence.

Verify real production budget scope through the actual controller paths, including competition/unknown/overrun and the media route where practical; reuse existing fixture adapters, do not force the rehearsal scope to stand in for production integration.

Connect search_project_context/MF-CONTEXT marker, typed local edit proposal, independent human review/approval, local renderer and receipt retrieval using controlled provider responses. Exact tool_result continuation consent remains mandatory. Reuse existing local workflow fixtures rather than rewriting editing/rendering.

Separate observed supported usage estimates, unsupported/unpriced usage and no-response uncertainty; inspect each current reservation/message attempt. Record the remaining trusted general-chat reconciliation path before live acceptance. Do not assign unknown billing dimensions to zero just to make the workflow pass.
acceptance_criteria: Default launch and disabled/invalid configuration acquire no secret and send nothing. Explicit validated enabled configuration can construct and run the actual production branch, without weakening per-round approval or opening it during this task.
Unconfigured direct non-test transport, fixture/live mixing, wrong workspace/model/price/connection revision, custom opener/URL and user-supplied activation fields fail closed.

Platform HTTP preview with actual mode uses project:<pid>, public actual destination and exact count/message byte hashes. No key access, reservation or send occurs merely by viewing the preview. Approval acquires exactly one reservation; count/message each have one fenced claim.

The first bounded count and message POSTs use exactly the approved bytes in an isolated test seam. A supported rich standard usage response with exact model executes only allowed client tools; the following result is sent only after fresh exact-manifest consent.

Missing/unknown/null/nonzero billing dimensions or model mismatch preserve observations and holds and do not execute tool effects. No skipped pricing checks, fallback model or retry. Counts are not invoices.

Production-mode chat and actual media controller paths account against the same project budget; competing admission, pre-claim uncertainty/overrun, post-claim edit, cancellation, restart, current-attempt unknown and other-project independence follow existing contracts.

An isolated controlled model response can read music facts and propose a local edit, then human approval and existing local renderer produce/inspect the result. Record fixture vs renderer vs future actual model evidence separately.

billing_recovery_followup_with_exact_bou.missing: A general-chat request-bound trusted reconciliation input/service, not another ledger algorithm.
proposed_scope_if_root_includes_it_befor: chat_general.py or a narrow chat_billing.py server-only helper
existing billing.manage contracts/operator path and focused tests only when an admissible receipt format/source is defined
must_bind: exact current reservation + chat-message attempt + request/manifest hash
validated provider request ID when available
evidence source/class/digest and exactly attributable monetary/billable dimensions
rules: Fixture evidence cannot settle live reservations. A model cannot provide or approve billing evidence. Late-review acknowledgement alone cannot release money.

An aggregate account bill cannot be assigned to one request without attributable evidence. Do not invent an Anthropic per-request billing endpoint or treat a supplied number as authenticated provider data.
Unknown/absent dimensions cannot be inferred as zero. Valid explicit usage remains an estimate unless a separate trusted cost record supports settlement; invoice confirmation remains distinct.

Reconciliation must be idempotent/conflict-audited and must not replay tools, requeue a request or silently issue another paid call. If attributable evidence is unavailable, preserve the hold and report the operational limit.
billing_recovery_followup_with_exact_bou.priority: This must be resolved or explicitly kept as a live-acceptance dependency. It does not justify leaving all clean-budget production execution unconditionally unreachable; it also must not be claimed completed by enabling configuration.

pricing_research_reuse.facts: Root research confirms the configured Haiku5.5 ID, first-party endpoints and current standard text rates against official sources; these were not independently re-browsed in this task.
pricing_research_reuse.policy: No rates, usage field inference or cost bounds changed. Current strict missing-field behavior remains unpriced; actual account response shapes and entitlement require separately authorized receipts.

external_account_test_needs: Explicit authorization for a bounded actual account test and selected workspace/project/conversation; no prior local fixture result grants this.
Credential supplier location/identity and access authority, confirmed account/region/model capability, without exposing the secret in API/UI/logs.
Exact approved synthetic or user-authorized prompt/tool-result data scope. Raw audio/photo/media files are outside this text-tool contract unless separately requested and consented.
A user-approved project budget, per-round and total maximum, maximum calls/rounds, price/version policy, time window and stop conditions.
Actual request IDs, response model/usage shapes, supported/unsupported billing evidence and cost reconciliation source; authenticate only under that scope.
Separate user workflow and actual MP4 output review, and keep AI-video-model tests deferred until production workflow acceptance as previously requested.
handoff: Concrete plan only; no implementation or activation was performed. Root should decide the next bounded write set and any real-account authorization separately. Stop after this evidence.
